SELECT
SUM(CASE WHEN CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) >= convert(DATE, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) VALID,
SUM(CASE WHEN CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) < convert(DATE, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) INVALID
FROM D360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP
WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT * FROM  EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE AS_OF_dATE='2024-01-25'
